notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API two-attribute scenario: the owner offers negotiated divestiture of only the requested attribute. A callback-local Confirm Divestiture containing both the requested and a second owner-published but unrequested attribute must throw AttributeDivestitureWasNotRequested, preserve both owner-held attributes, and produce no acquisition notification. A subsequent confirmation of only the requested attribute succeeds and transfers just that attribute. The pinned native mapping is page-159-l53-11 -> §7.6.3; metadata and ownership-state assertions beyond that selected fragment are supplemental public-API observations. Process transport and MOM service reporting are excluded. Adapter supplies provider, endpoint, two-attribute FOM and names, callback model and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime execution evidence. This is not a conformance claim.
